label: Opening Hook
text: Beneath the city of Odesa runs one of the largest tunnel networks in the world, dug mostly by limestone miners.
title: Odesa-Catacombs of Moldovanka-entrance

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Estimated at roughly 2,500 km (about 1,500 miles) of tunnels Mostly former limestone quarries; the stone was used to build the city in the 19th century Used by smugglers, and by Soviet partisans during World War II Large parts are unmapped, and people have died after getting lost A small section is open as a museum
title: Odessa Catacombs Monument
